For a 50-person Indian company, these three are practical benchmarks. Public corporate pricing is mostly quote-based, so I would not treat any invented per-booking figure as reliable.

Provider	Cost structure	Switching difficulty
MakeMyTrip myBiz
	₹0 annual subscription; transaction/service fees can apply by contract. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Low — self-serve setup, employee invites and policy configuration. 
MakeMyTrip Business

Yatra for Business
	Travel Lite targets SMEs under ₹1 crore/year; Travel Pro covers businesses under ₹5 crore/year. Pricing is enquiry-based. 
Yatra.com
	Low–medium — policies, approvals, reports and multiple booking channels require migration of employee/travel data.
FCM Travel India
	Quote-based managed TMC; negotiated corporate rates and dedicated service rather than published subscription pricing. 
FCM Travel
+1
	Medium–high — implementation, policy configuration, integrations and traveller profiles make migration more involved. 
FCM Travel

Practical takeaway: myBiz is easiest to switch into/out of; Yatra offers a similar SME-oriented model; FCM is a deeper managed-service migration. For a 50-person company, request each vendor's per-booking/service fee, implementation fee, minimum annual spend, cancellation/change charges and exit terms before comparing total cost.

For a ₹10 lakh/month Mumbai D2C store:

Gateway	Transaction fee*	Settlement	Checkout	Onboarding
Razorpay	~2% + GST	T+1; instant settlement available	Excellent D2C checkout, UPI, cards, 100+ methods	Fast, strong integrations
Cashfree Payments	~1.95% + GST**	T+1; instant settlement option	Strong UPI/card checkout, good APIs	Quick, KYC-based
PayU	~2% + GST**	T+1/T+2; priority settlement available	150+ payment modes, strong success-rate focus	Established, more enterprise-oriented

Razorpay offers D2C-focused Magic Checkout and instant settlements. 
razorpay.com
 PayU supports 150+ modes, priority settlements and D2C checkout/RTO tools. 
payu.in

My pick: Cashfree for cost, Razorpay for overall D2C experience. Actual rates are negotiable; confirm your merchant quote before switching.
